newsitem.title: FRANCE: France to sell 16 to 18 bln Ffr of OATs Thursday.
newsitem.headline: France to sell 16 to 18 bln Ffr of OATs Thursday.

text.p: PARIS, Oct 1, Reuter - France is to offer between 16 and 18 billion francs of government bonds (OATs) at its next scheduled auction on October 3, the Treasury said on Tuesday.
The Treasury will offer the current 10-year benchmark bond, the 6.50 percent October 25, 2006 OAT, with a payment date of October 25, the statement said.
The Treasury also said it would offer the 6.50 percent April 25, 2011 OAT and the TEC 10 variable rate bond, both with a payment date of October 25.
